name: meds
description: The current regimen, the latest statement about each medication course, with stopped courses gone. Serve it at a fact-time bound for 'what was I on, on that day'. A single dose (health.medication.dose) is not a regimen statement and stays out, so the list names the three regimen types and not the prefix health.medication., which would bring in doses, missed doses and compliance. Version 4 names the same types as version 3 and only rewords this description. Version 3 gave the types their third segment; version 2 named them under the health domain.
